assumptions: inspection zone (approach lanes just before the stop line) is taken as the near side of the intersection where the stop must occur.
packing_entry line (stop line across the approach lanes) is taken as the clearly marked stop line.
Downward travel (+y) across the stop line is encoded as direction to_right per line definition and used as the approaching crossing direction.
A stop is interpreted as remaining continuously stationary (max_speed 0.05) in the inspection zone for at least 1000 ms; the statute states no duration.
Anchor bottom_center is used because vehicles contact the road at wheels and zones/lines are drawn at road surface.
No time limit is imposed between the stop and the crossing; any earlier dwell satisfies the rule.
Vehicles that never cross the stop line pass vacuously via IMPLIES.
The Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal exception is not visible to the camera and is excluded from the check.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line must have first stopped stationary in the inspection zone before crossing.

provenance.reason: Vehicles touch the road at wheels; inspection zone and stop line are drawn at road surface so ground-contact point is tested.
inspection is defined as the approach lanes just before the stop line, corresponding to the near side where the stop must occur.
Statute states shall stop with no duration; 1000 ms continuous stationary period chosen as minimum observable stop.
Statute says shall stop; 0.05 means only while stopped/still per DSL, enforcing stationary stop.
packing_entry is defined as the stop line across approach lanes, corresponding to the clearly marked stop line.
Cars travel top to bottom; moving downwards (+y) is defined as to_right, the approaching/crossing direction.
Statute states no maximum interval between stop and crossing, so no time limit is imposed.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
